description: This Java interface defines a contract for entity IDs that include a namespace component, ensuring immutability and validation with regex patterns.

classes.name: NamespacedEntityId
classes.description: A Java interface for entity IDs that include a namespace, extending EntityId and requiring implementations to provide getName() and getNamespace() methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name part of the entity ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace part of the entity ID.
